verses.ar: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦٓ أَنۡ أَنذِرۡ قَوۡمَكَ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن يَأۡتِيَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمࣱ‏
verses.en: Lo! We sent Noah unto his people (saying): Warn thy people ere the painful doom come unto them

verses.ar: قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ إِنِّي لَكُمۡ نَذِيرࣱ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: He said: O my people! Lo! I am a plain warner unto you

verses.ar: أَنِ ٱعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verses.en: (Bidding you): Serve Allah and keep your duty unto Him and obey me

verses.ar: يَغۡفِرۡ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمۡ وَيُؤَخِّرۡكُمۡ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلࣲ مُّسَمًّىۚ إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُۚ لَوۡ كُنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ
verses.en: That He may forgive you somewhat of your sins and respite you to an appointed term. Lo! the term of Allah, when it cometh, cannot be delayed, if ye but knew

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي دَعَوۡتُ قَوۡمِي لَيۡلࣰ ا وَنَهَارࣰ ا
verses.en: He said: My Lord! Lo! I have called unto my people night and day

verses.ar: فَلَمۡ يَزِدۡهُمۡ دُعَآءِيٓ إِلَّا فِرَارࣰ ا
verses.en: But all my calling doth but add to their repugnance

verses.ar: وَإِنِّي كُلَّمَا دَعَوۡتُهُمۡ لِتَغۡفِرَ لَهُمۡ جَعَلُوٓاْ أَصَٰبِعَهُمۡ فِيٓ ءَاذَانِهِمۡ وَٱسۡتَغۡشَوۡاْ ثِيَابَهُمۡ وَأَصَرُّواْ وَٱسۡتَكۡبَرُواْ ٱسۡتِكۡبَارࣰ ا
verses.en: And lo! whenever I call unto them that Thou mayst pardon them they thrust their fingers in their ears and cover themselves with their garments and persist (in their refusal) and magnify themselves in pride

verses.ar: ثُمَّ إِنِّي دَعَوۡتُهُمۡ جِهَارࣰ ا
verses.en: And lo! I have called unto them aloud

verses.ar: ثُمَّ إِنِّيٓ أَعۡلَنتُ لَهُمۡ وَأَسۡرَرۡتُ لَهُمۡ إِسۡرَارࣰ ا
verses.en: And lo! I have made public proclamation unto them, and I have appealed to them in private

verses.ar: فَقُلۡتُ ٱسۡتَغۡفِرُواْ رَبَّكُمۡ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارࣰ ا
verses.en: And I have said: Seek pardon of your Lord. Lo! He was ever Forgiving

verses.ar: يُرۡسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيۡكُم مِّدۡرَارࣰ ا
verses.en: He will let loose the sky for you in plenteous rain

verses.ar: وَيُمۡدِدۡكُم بِأَمۡوَٰلࣲ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجۡعَل لَّكُمۡ جَنَّٰتࣲ وَيَجۡعَل لَّكُمۡ أَنۡهَٰرࣰ ا
verses.en: And will help you with wealth and sons, and will assign unto you Gardens and will assign unto you rivers

verses.ar: مَّا لَكُمۡ لَا تَرۡجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارࣰ ا
verses.en: What aileth you that ye hope not toward Allah for dignity

verses.ar: وَقَدۡ خَلَقَكُمۡ أَطۡوَارًا
verses.en: When He created you by (divers) stages

verses.ar: أَلَمۡ تَرَوۡاْ كَيۡفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبۡعَ سَمَٰوَٰتࣲ طِبَاقࣰ ا
verses.en: See ye not how Allah hath created seven heavens in harmony

verses.ar: وَجَعَلَ ٱلۡقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورࣰ ا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمۡسَ سِرَاجࣰ ا
verses.en: And hath made the moon a light therein, and made the sun a lamp

verses.ar: وَٱللَّهُ أَنۢبَتَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ نَبَاتࣰ ا
verses.en: And Allah hath caused you to grow as a growth from the earth

verses.ar: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمۡ فِيهَا وَيُخۡرِجُكُمۡ إِخۡرَاجࣰ ا
verses.en: And afterward He maketh you return thereto, and He will bring you forth again, a (new) forthbringing

verses.ar: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِسَاطࣰ ا
verses.en: And Allah hath made the earth a wide expanse for you

verses.ar: لِّتَسۡلُكُواْ مِنۡهَا سُبُلࣰ ا فِجَاجࣰ ا
verses.en: That ye may thread the valley-ways thereof

verses.ar: قَالَ نُوحࣱ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمۡ عَصَوۡنِي وَٱتَّبَعُواْ مَن لَّمۡ يَزِدۡهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارࣰ ا
verses.en: Noah said: My Lord! Lo! they have disobeyed me and followed one whose wealth and children increase him in naught save ruin

verses.ar: وَمَكَرُواْ مَكۡرࣰ ا كُبَّارࣰ ا
verses.en: And they have plotted a mighty plot

verses.ar: وَقَالُواْ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمۡ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدࣰّ ا وَلَا سُوَاعࣰ ا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسۡرࣰ ا
verses.en: And they have said: Forsake not your gods. Forsake not Wadd, nor Suwa', nor Yaghuth and Ya'uq and Nasr

verses.ar: وَقَدۡ أَضَلُّواْ كَثِيرࣰ اۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَٰلࣰ ا
verses.en: And they have led many astray, and Thou increasest the wrong-doers in naught save error

verses.ar: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٰٔتِهِمۡ أُغۡرِقُواْ فَأُدۡخِلُواْ نَارࣰ ا فَلَمۡ يَجِدُواْ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارࣰ ا
verses.en: Because of their sins they were drowned, then made to enter a Fire. And they found they had no helpers in place of Allah

verses.ar: وَقَالَ نُوحࣱ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرۡ عَلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ دَيَّارًا
verses.en: And Noah said: My Lord! Leave not one of the disbelievers in the land

verses.ar: إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرۡهُمۡ يُضِلُّواْ عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوٓاْ إِلَّا فَاجِرࣰ ا كَفَّارࣰ ا
verses.en: If Thou shouldst leave them, they will mislead Thy slaves and will beget none save lewd ingrates

verses.ar: رَّبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَلِوَٰلِدَيَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيۡتِيَ مُؤۡمِنࣰ ا وَلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارَۢا
verses.en: My Lord! Forgive me and my parents and him who entereth my house believing, and believing men and believing women, and increase not the wrong-doers in aught save ruin
